faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLE450 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 2015 to 2019 (W166 generation), the GLE450 used the M276 3.0-litre V6 petrol. From 2019 onwards (V167), it switched to the M256 3.0-litre inline-six petrol with mild hybrid technology — a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLE450 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLE450?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M276 or the M256 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M276 GLE450 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every M276 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M256 GLE450 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M256 is a more modern engine and we service it to the same high standard as the M276, replacing timing chain components, bearings, and gaskets.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLE450 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLE450 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an GLE450 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLE450 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
